name: Bread Pakora
subtitle: bread stuffed with spiced potato, dipped in gram flour batter and fried
prepNotes: Use bread that has dried a little. Fresh soft bread drinks oil and collapses.
Press the sandwich firmly before battering so the filling does not escape into the pan.

steps.text: Mix the crushed potato with chilli, ginger, amchur, chaat masala, coriander and salt.
Spread thickly on four slices, top with the rest and press down hard. Cut each into two triangles.
Whisk the besan with turmeric, chilli powder, salt and water into a batter thick enough to cling.
steps.tip: Thicker than a pakora batter. It has to seal the cut edges.

steps.text: Heat the oil to 175C. Dip each triangle, making sure the cut sides are covered, and lower it in.
Fry 3 minutes a side until deep gold and crisp.
Drain, cut once more if you like, dust with chaat masala and serve with tamarind chutney.

storage: Eat straight away. These go soggy faster than any other fried snack.
